channel.title: Ali Spagnola
channel.description:
Hey best Pal-y! I'm Ali! I make…

1. OUTRAGEOUS MUSIC: I ask "What if" a popular song was done by a different artist? Then create that song and music video for you
2. OUTRAGEOUS ART & CREATIONS: I come up with over-the-top, never been done before DIY projects and artwork, then make them for you
3. More creative Outrageous surprises

My Pal-ys and I believe life should be about creating a fascinati

videos.t: Do the BAC: Preview of The Power Hour Album Re-release
videos.desc:
The Power Hour Album will be re-released, new and improved. 60 songs that are guaranteed to be 60 times better. (Especially if you're drinking.) And they're still all one minute long. The party starting-ness of this CD has increased beyond your ability to comprehend without experiencing it. So get your shot glass ready and don't miss the release coming later this year.

This is a preview the 37th track, "Do the BAC". Get more info here: http://www.alispagnola.com/powerhour/2011/02/the-power-hour-album-re-release-coming-later-this-year/
